text:
lina: quick idea — can we show a lightweight quota/cost affordance inline for Console "QuickViews"? users create filters and saved views but have no sense of token cost or quota impact.

aj: yes please. at minimum show a per-minute QPS estimate + rough cost per 1k tokens for the view's typical date range. helps teams choose a narrower window.

sam: curious about scope: should QuickViews be team-scoped by default or org-shared? that changes how we show quotas (team quota vs org quota).

beth: i'm leaning default -> team. most folks want private saves first, then opt-in share. we can add a "share to org" toggle that requires owner consent. :+1:

marco: backend note — if we add cost estimates we need an endpoint that can compute approximate token counts without re-running heavy queries. propose augmenting GET /api/v1/console/views to return a small summary payload:

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "filters": "...",
  "estimatedAvgTokens": 1200,
  "estimatedCostPerCallMicros": 450,
  "visibility": "team|org|private"
}
```

marco: estimate fields computed from sample traffic distribution; stored in metadata and recomputed nightly. expensive path only for manual "recompute".

aj: ok but make the API opt-in for older clients. version it as v2 so console can fetch estimates only when supported. also add a boolean `hasCostHint`.

lina: UX question — where do we show it? inline on saved view list? hover? header chip?

beth: small chip on the saved view card: "~$0.45 / 1k tokens · est 1.2k tokens" and tooltip for breakdown (qps, sample window). hover is fine for power users but chip is discoverable.

sam: plus show a tiny telemetry toggle: "include view in route-level evals" — if on, it contributes to quality monitoring and alerts. default off for org-shared to avoid noisy telemetry.

marco: adding telemetry opt-in will require a new flag in the view model: `publishToTelemetry:true|false`. also need opt-out from downstream eval pipelines.

aj: one more: saved view ownership metadata. we need `pinned_by`, `created_by_team`, and `last_recomputed_at` in the API so client can show owner and recompute freshness.

lina: timeline proposal: 1) API v2 schema w/ estimates + visibility + telemetry flag (marco) 2) Console chip + hover (beth) 3) defaults: team-scope, telemetry off for org-shared (sam) 4) nightly recompute job + manual recompute action in UI (marco)

marco: I'll sketch the DB migration: add columns estimated_avg_tokens:int, estimated_cost_micros:int, visibility:varchar, publish_telemetry:bool, last_recomputed_ts:int. avoid backfill for old rows — compute on access for top N.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for branch feature/quickviews-cost-hint (build #4821). :rocket:

aj: action items: marco -> API + migration PR, beth -> small mockups for chip/tooltip, sam -> privacy text for org-share, lina -> write short product doc for rollout and opt-in metrics. target: next sprint.

lina: thanks everyone. keeping it small and reversible. :raised_hands:
